method: One stage at a time, every other stage at today's default. Seer and Comparator rows run the store's page set (38 seeded faults, 20 clean controls); Judge and Fixer rows re-use the verified findings of the first recorded run of 4 Nov, so every model sees the same findings; Navigator rows walk the purchase flow with no fixes. In Seer, Comparator and Navigator rows the judge ran on the contributor tier of the same model (a judgement enters neither recall nor precision); "Cost with the default judge" projects the row at the default judge's price per finding. Accuracy is over the faults and the clean controls: a clean control with no finding is a true negative. A row with n = 1 is a sample, not a measurement of spread. A gap counts as closed only when the sighted text appears in the new accessible name, so a barrier sighted as a description ("trash icon button") cannot pass with a correct name such as "Remove item": read gaps closed with "Comparator still flags". muse-spark-1.1 has no price in our table; its rows print the price as unknown and cannot win on cost. A Navigator run that an API error ended counts for screens but not for turns. All 3 such runs here had audited all four screens and failed on turn 12, the last turn, which offers only finish after an audit_view: a request our agent loop built at every effort, since fixed (d293707). The walks ran with twelve turns and before the executor's click correction (1e43af0), and were not re-measured.
